{"acl":["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres","service_role=X/postgres"],"name":"check_in_ticket","owner":"postgres","result":"TABLE(registration_id uuid, event_id uuid, student_id uuid, student_name text, checked_in_at timestamp with time zone)","schema":"public","language":"plpgsql","settings":["search_path="""],"arguments":"p_registration_id uuid, p_event_id uuid, p_student_id uuid","signature":"check_in_ticket(uuid,uuid,uuid)","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_in_ticket(p_registration_id uuid, p_event_id uuid, p_student_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(registration_id uuid, event_id uuid, student_id uuid, student_name text, checked_in_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_organizer uuid := auth.uid();
  v_registration public.registrations%ROWTYPE;
  v_student_name text;
  v_checked_at timestamptz;
BEGIN
  IF v_organizer IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required.';
  END IF;

  -- Only the organizer who owns this published
  -- event can check in students.
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.events AS e
    JOIN public.profiles AS p
      ON p.id = v_organizer
    WHERE e.id = p_event_id
      AND e.organizer_id = v_organizer
      AND e.status = 'published'
      AND p.role = 'organizer'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'You are not authorized to scan this event.';
  END IF;

  -- Validate the registration and ticket.
  SELECT r.*
  INTO v_registration
  FROM public.registrations AS r
  WHERE r.id = p_registration_id
    AND r.event_id = p_event_id
    AND r.student_id = p_student_id
    AND r.status = 'registered';

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Invalid or cancelled ticket.';
  END IF;

  SELECT p.full_name
  INTO v_student_name
  FROM public.profiles AS p
  WHERE p.id = v_registration.student_id;

  -- FIX:
  -- Use ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT instead of
  -- ON CONFLICT (registration_id).
  INSERT INTO public.attendance (
    registration_id,
    event_id,
    scanned_by
  )
  VALUES (
    v_registration.id,
    v_registration.event_id,
    v_organizer
  )
  ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT attendance_registration_id_key
  DO NOTHING
  RETURNING public.attendance.checked_in_at
  INTO v_checked_at;

  IF v_checked_at IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'This ticket has already been checked in.';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    v_registration.id,
    v_registration.event_id,
    v_registration.student_id,
    COALESCE(v_student_name, ''),
    v_checked_at;
END;
$function$
","security_definer":true}

{"acl":["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres","service_role=X/postgres"],"name":"get_attendance_records","owner":"postgres","result":"TABLE(registration_id uuid, event_id uuid, student_id uuid, student_name text, registered_at timestamp with time zone, checked_in_at timestamp with time zone)","schema":"public","language":"sql","settings":["search_path="""],"arguments":"","signature":"get_attendance_records()","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_attendance_records()
 RETURNS TABLE(registration_id uuid, event_id uuid, student_id uuid, student_name text, registered_at timestamp with time zone, checked_in_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    r.id,
    r.event_id,
    r.student_id,
    p.full_name,
    r.registered_at,
    a.checked_in_at
  from public.registrations r
  join public.events e
    on e.id = r.event_id
  join public.profiles p
    on p.id = r.student_id
  left join public.attendance a
    on a.registration_id = r.id
  where auth.uid() is not null
    and r.status = 'registered'
    and (
      r.student_id = auth.uid()
      or (
        e.organizer_id = auth.uid()
        and exists (
          select 1
          from public.profiles organizer
          where organizer.id = auth.uid()
            and organizer.role = 'organizer'
        )
      )
    );
$function$

  left join public.registrations r
